# Kaltura’s Israeli school pilot starts with grades 7–8 STEM


By OpenTools Team


Hebrew and Arabic are available; language subjects remain planned.


##


Initial classroom scope


Kaltura says classroom use is underway after teacher training in a one‑year pilot across 20 schools serving approximately 2,000 students. Its[November 3 announcement](https://investors.kaltura.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kaltura-selected-israels-ministry-education-power-personalized) places initial work in seventh- and eighth‑grade mathematics and science during 2026–2027, with Hebrew and Arabic available.


Avatar conversations, practice and teacher progress dashboards describe the workflow; the release supplies no independent learning‑gain evaluation.


##


Expansion remains prospective


[English and other language studies](https://investors.kaltura.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kaltura-selected-israels-ministry-education-power-personalized) are planned next. Extending across grades and subjects nationally is a programme goal. Administrators should distinguish this cohort from later expansion; the announcement does not establish public enrolment or student‑data retention terms.


Original source‑based illustration; classroom languages and planned subjects are distinct. Figure: OpenTools Team.
